mapper.select: SELECT B_MAIN_NO, CASE WHEN B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE B_MAIN_TYPE END AS B_MAIN_TYPE FROM BOARD_TYPE_MAIN ORDER BY B_MAIN_NO

SELECT B_SUB_NO, B_MAIN_NO, CASE WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE B_SUB_TYPE END AS B_SUB_TYPE FROM BOARD_TYPE_SUB ORDER BY B_MAIN_NO, B_SUB_NO

SELECT LOCAL_NO, CASE WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'SEO' THEN '서울' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'INC' THEN '인천' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'PUS' THEN '부산' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'DAE' THEN '대구' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GWA' THEN '광주' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'DAJ' THEN '대전' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'ULS' THEN '울산' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'SEJ' THEN '세종' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GYE' THEN '경기' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GAN' THEN '강원' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'CHU' THEN '충청' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'JEO' THEN '전라' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GYS' THEN '경상' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'JEJ' THEN '제주' ELSE LOCAL_NAME END AS LOCAL_NAME FROM BOARD_TYPE_LOCAL ORDER BY LOCAL_NO

SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.B_SUB_NO, B.LOCAL_NO, B.TITLE, B.B_CONTENT, B.USER_ID, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.B_STATUS, B.PRIVATE, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(B.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDATE_TIME,
CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE BTS.B_SUB_TYPE END AS B_SUB_TYPE,
CASE WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE END AS B_MAIN_TYPE,
IFNULL(LK.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT, IFNULL(CM.COMMENT_CNT, 0) AS COMMENT_CNT,
BF.FILE_PATH, BF.FILE_NAME, CONCAT(BF.FILE_PATH, BF.FILE_NAME) AS THUMBNAIL
FROM BOARD B
INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO
INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_MAIN BTM ON BTS.B_MAIN_NO = BTM.B_MAIN_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM BOARD_LIKE GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) LK ON B.BOARD_NO = LK.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM COMMENT GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) CM ON B.BOARD_NO = CM.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, MIN(FILE_NO) AS FILE_NO FROM BOARD_FILE GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) BFM ON B.BOARD_NO = BFM.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN BOARD_FILE BF ON BFM.FILE_NO = BF.FILE_NO
WHERE B.B_STATUS = 'Y'
AND BTM.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo}
AND BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = #{integratedCategory}
AND BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = #{localCategory}
AND B.LOCAL_NO = #{localNo}
AND (
B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
B.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
LIKE_CNT DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
B.VIEW_COUNT DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
B.BOARD_NO DESC
LIMIT #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}

SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.B_SUB_NO, B.LOCAL_NO, B.TITLE, B.B_CONTENT, B.USER_ID, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.B_STATUS, B.PRIVATE, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(B.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDATE_TIME, CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE BTS.B_SUB_TYPE END AS B_SUB_TYPE, CASE WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE END AS B_MAIN_TYPE, CASE WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'SEO' THEN '서울' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'INC' THEN '인천' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'PUS' THEN '부산' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'DAE' THEN '대구' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GWA' THEN '광주' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'DAJ' THEN '대전' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'ULS' THEN '울산' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'SEJ' THEN '세종' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GYE' THEN '경기' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GAN' THEN '강원' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'CHU' THEN '충청' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'JEO' THEN '전라' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GYS' THEN '경상' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'JEJ' THEN '제주' ELSE BTL.LOCAL_NAME END AS LOCAL_NAME FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_MAIN BTM ON BTS.B_MAIN_NO = BTM.B_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_LOCAL BTL ON B.LOCAL_NO = BTL.LOCAL_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT FILE_NO, BOARD_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS FILE_URL FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO
